newsitem.title: USA: Magellan Health to sell hospitals in Britain, Switzerland.
newsitem.headline: Magellan Health to sell hospitals in Britain, Switzerland.

text.p: Magellan Health Services Inc. said Wednesday it signed definitive agreements to sell its two psychiatric hospitals in London and another in Switzerland.

Financial details were not disclosed, although Magellan said the transactions will provide it with about $72 million, of which about $45 million will be recorded as a gain for financial reporting purposes.

Magellan said the two transactions were with units of Priory Hospitals Group, Britain's largest private provider of acute psychiatric care, which is owned by Mercury Asset Management, the largest independent fund manager in Britain.
The company also said that as part of the deal, it will allow Priory to continue to use the "Charter" name at the facilities for seven years.

Priory will also be allowed to use Magellan's "Charter System," composed of certain intellectual and proprietary rights, for six months while the companies negotiate a potential franchise relationship.
Magellan said the deal was part of its strategy to take advantage of its managed care and public health expertise through licensing and franchising.
Atlanta-based Magellan's stock lost 12.5 cents to $24.375 in late morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
